subject.title: Dashboard: chart widgets + widget authoring SDK

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor chart rendering and widget authoring as bundled first-party dashboard capabilities after the storage and foundation blockers are resolved?
rationale: The linked feature issues leave bundled builtin scope versus external/custom widget distribution to maintainers, and the feature depends on an unmerged dashboard platform with default, persistence, and security implications.

options.title: Sponsor Bundled Charts
options.body: Accept the bounded chart and authoring surfaces after the architecture, foundation, proof, and review blockers are cleared.

options.title: Externalize First
options.body: Keep charting and templates on the custom-widget or plugin path until the dashboard ecosystem proves demand.

options.title: Pause With Foundation
options.body: Hold this PR until the broader modular-dashboard product direction is settled.

recommendation.title: Sponsor Bundled Charts
recommendation.body: Accept the bounded chart and authoring surfaces after the architecture, foundation, proof, and review blockers are cleared.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and recently maintained the plugin-contributed Control UI tab seam this proposal extends.
